supp.addWheyWhenCreating: Add whey when creating a menu if protein falls short
supp.creatineHoldsWaterIn: Creatine holds water in muscle, so the scale may show +0.5–1.5 kg in the first weeks — this is not fat.
supp.everyDayTrainingAnd: Every day — training and rest days
supp.iDrank1Scoop: I drank 1 scoop of whey (add to the daily total)
supp.steroidsTestosteroneSarmsProhormone: steroids, testosterone, SARMs, prohormones and other anabolic drugs. The goal is a natural result — protecting hormonal balance matters especially after varicocele surgery. Consult a doctor before taking any additional drug.
supp.wheyNotMainFood: Whey is not a main food — it is only for covering a shortfall when the protein target is not met with meals.
supp.withWaterOrFood: With water or food; no "loading" needed
